name: Berry Pink Power Smoothie
steps: Add the strawberries, 50g of the raspberries, cherries, banana, almond milk, yoghurt and protein powder to a blender. Grate in the zest of the lime and then squeeze in the juice.
Blitz until smooth. Pour into a glass.
Crush the remaining 25g frozen raspberries with the back of a spoon, then spoon over the top. Serve straight away – cold, creamy and berry-packed.
